catalogDescription: Browse artwork, choose an artist and build an order from their price list.
error: The action could not be completed. Check your input and try again.
choose: Choose items from the price list
title: Order title
brief: Describe the task, preferences and delivery requirements
filesHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF, up to 20 MiB each, at most 10 files. Only participants and the assigned arbiter in a dispute can access files.
agree: I have read the terms, checked the selected items and understand that payment takes place outside this site.
privacy: If a dispute is opened, the assigned arbiter can access the brief, messages, files and payment history.
selectWorks: Choose your artwork for the portfolio
paymentHint: This site does not process payments. “I paid” is a customer report; only the artist confirms receipt.
instructions: Payment details and instructions (private to the order)
cancelPending: Cancellation requested. Money is not refunded automatically.
disputeOpen: A dispute is open. Completion and cancellation are paused until a decision.
ratingPrivate: Visible only to artists. Do not include personal information or private messages.
noRatings: No ratings from completed orders yet.
obligations: Obligations: deliverables, remaining payment, refund and deadlines
refundHint: A refund decision does not mean the money has been returned. The artist records sending it with evidence; the customer confirms receipt.
externalOnly: The site records obligations but does not transfer funds or guarantee enforcement.
accessDenied: You need the appropriate permissions to access this section.

errors.PRICE_CHANGED: The price list changed. Check your selection and total again; your brief has been kept.
errors.STALE_ORDER: The order changed. Data has been refreshed; check it before trying again.
errors.STALE_PROFILE: The price list changed in another tab. Refresh before saving.
errors.STALE_CASE: The case changed. Check its current state.
errors.INVALID_FILE_TYPE: Only PNG, JPEG, WebP and PDF files are supported.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than 20 MiB.
errors.UPLOAD_QUOTA: Daily upload limit reached (100 files / 200 MiB).
errors.REVISIONS_EXHAUSTED: Included revisions have been used. Discuss next steps in the chat.
errors.PAYMENT_TOTAL_MISMATCH: Payment stages must add up to the order total.
errors.PREPAYMENT_REQUIRED: Confirm all prepayments before starting work.
errors.PAYMENT_REQUIRED: Full payment must be confirmed before completion.
errors.DISPUTE_OPEN: The open dispute must be resolved first.
errors.REFUND_EXCEEDS_PAYMENT: The refund exceeds the available confirmed payment.
errors.AUTHOR_REQUIRED: This section is for artists only.
errors.ARTIST_UNAVAILABLE: The artist is no longer accepting orders.
errors.REVIEW_LOCKED: The review is under investigation or hidden; editing is unavailable.
errors.REFUND_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Attach evidence that the refund was sent.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check required fields and allowed values.
